method_limits: Source pixels only; no letters, historical keys, old repeat groups, corpus, scorer, optimizer, other reader outputs or network used.
No resize, filter, OCR, retouch or removal. Approximate native locations are observations, not traced masks.
All 16 frozen whole-unit overlay conflicts remain deferred. Existing records are not altered.
Complete feature construction is required for any later comparison; common low body curves alone do not justify equivalence.
Candidate eligibility supports feature comparison, not cipher function, alphabet identity, or proof that every dark pixel is writing.
repeat_proposal_note: No strict repeat pair is asserted by this independent pass. Unit feature inventories, explicit unresolved alternatives, and retained negative comparisons are supplied for subsequent reconciliation and cross-region comparison.
